messages:
Aisha (CS): Heads-up — we've identified a degradation impacting embedding lookups for a subset of customers who onboarded March 10–12. Some retrievals return 500s or older vectors. I'm drafting outbound customer comms. Adding status here so we can coordinate messaging and mitigation. :warning:

Kai (SRE): Investigating. Initial signal shows high compaction activity in embeddings-store around 03:14 UTC that overlapped with a replay job. Possible partial tombstoning. Switched compactor to read-only and paused replay at 03:40. Rolling a hotfix now.

Nora (Eng): Quick technical note for CS: root cause likely a race in compactor metadata merge that incorrectly marked certain KS shards as trimmed while replay was writing. Patch is building: hotfix-embed-compact-v2. Will push to canary in 15m.

Aisha (CS): Thank you. Draft outbound to affected customers below — please flag any technical inaccuracies: 

---
Hi <account-team>,

We wanted to let you know about a recent issue that affected embedding lookups for customers who onboarded March 10–12. Between ~03:10–03:45 UTC we had a storage compaction bug that caused intermittent failures and stale results for some queries. Our engineers have deployed a hotfix and are rehydrating affected embeddings from backups.

What this means for you:
- You may have seen 500 errors or unexpected search results during the window above.
- Rehydration jobs are in progress; most accounts will see normal results again within 1–3 hours.
- If you rely on real-time indexing during onboarding, we recommend rerunning the final consistency check once we confirm completion.

Mitigation we’re taking:
- Deployed hotfix to compaction logic (hotfix-embed-compact-v2). :white_check_mark:
- Rehydration/reindex jobs queued for affected orgs; prioritized by usage and SLA.
- We will proactively run a consistency check for your account and share a completion note.

Next steps:
- We’ll follow up with a root-cause summary and exact timing once the jobs finish.
- If you’d like a dedicated call to review impact, we can schedule one and provide logs.

We’re really sorry for the disruption — we’ll apply a credit for any measurable downtime and help with any reindexing needed.

Best,
Aisha and the Redwood team
---

Aisha (CS): Please suggest wording or additional items. Also which accounts should we mark as renewal-risk outreach?

Liam (CS): High-priority list for proactive 1:1s: TandemHealth, BeaconPay, ClearDocs — all with active onboarding flows this week. Flagging TandemHealth as high renewal-risk if they see multiple failed demos.

Olga (AE): Agreed. I’ll reach out to TandemHealth immediately and offer a shared troubleshooting/ops call. Also propose a one-week credits package; we can escalate for larger customers.

Kai (SRE): Canary deploy succeeded. Patch rolled to prod at 03:58 UTC. Rehydration jobs started at 04:05 UTC via the reindex queue. Typical reindex throughput ~1 org/min depending on vectors. If you need per-account ETA run: `redwood-admin reindex status --org <org-id>`

Nora (Eng): RCA draft (short): compactor metadata merge + concurrent replay -> partial tombstone write -> some vector segments marked unavailable. Fix: serialized compactor merges and stronger pre-commit checks. Postmortem will include timeline, tests added, and backfill plan.

Aisha (CS): Nice. Can someone confirm which accounts have completed rehydration? I want to send individualized follow-ups.

Kai (SRE): Current status (summary):
- TandemHealth: reindex queued, in-progress (30% done) ETA ~35m
- BeaconPay: reindex complete, verified :white_check_mark:
- ClearDocs: failed once, retry queued, ETA ~50m
- Others (10 small orgs): mostly complete or not affected

Aisha (CS): Perfect. I'll send the outbound updates now to BeaconPay (resolved) and TandemHealth/ClearDocs (in-progress). Offering credit + ops call for TandemHealth.

Liam (CS): Quick note for renewal team: mark TandemHealth as "engaged at-risk" in CRM and schedule AE/CS sync after we finish reindex.

Olga (AE): TandemHealth response: "Appreciate the transparency — please prioritize our demo window." I scheduled a 30-min call for 10:00 PT.

incident-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0310-embed-compact (investigating -> identified -> mitigation deployed -> monitoring)

Nora (Eng): Follow-up items for postmortem and CS ops:
- Full list of affected orgs + time ranges (exported from compactor logs)
- Per-org verification checklist and script for CS ops to confirm vector freshness
- Automated alert to pause compactor during replay windows

Aisha (CS): I'll draft the customer-facing RCA for tomorrow morning and include per-account notes. Thanks everyone — call out if a customer needs escalation before then. :pray:

Kai (SRE): Final update: all high-priority orgs either complete or actively progressing. Monitoring for <24h for regressions. Closing incident channel once postmortem drafts ready.

Aisha (CS): Closing loop — customers notified, credits offered where applicable, renewal team notified for risk follow-up. Will paste the final RCA here when ready. :white_check_mark:
